problems.text: The Designer thinks the meeting creation flow is confusing, with too many steps
Creating a meeting means clicking through title, description, attendees, time and then confirm, five steps, when most of the time only attendees and time are wanted
The Designer feels the flow is slow because of the mental load of clicking through a dialog

proposed_solutions.text: Streamline the flow to two steps: a quick mode for just attendees and time, or a full mode for all the details
Add tracking to see how many users change the attendees or description after creating a meeting (Engineer Lead's suggestion)

user_segments.text: Users who create meetings; the only evidence is the Designer's own daily use of the app

requests.text: The Designer wants the flow streamlined into a quick mode and a full mode

decisions.text: Add some analytics this sprint and revisit next month

open_questions.text: Are customers complaining about the flow? The Designer has not formally asked
How much faster would a two-step flow be? The Designer does not know
Does this hold up with real users? It has not been tested with any
How many users change the attendees or description after creating a meeting? This would show whether anyone cares about the order

action_items.text: Product Lead to add some analytics this sprint

metrics_mentioned.text: The current flow has five steps
Time saved by a two-step flow: "maybe a few seconds", a guess by the Designer
